key_insights.title: Go's Sweet 16 - Production Maturity Milestone
key_insights.description: 16th anniversary celebrated November 10, 2025. Continued focus on production systems, testing innovations (synctest package), and explicit AI infrastructure roadmap.
key_insights.evidence: 232 HN points, Go 1.24/1.25 releases with testing improvements, AI infrastructure announcement
key_insights.application: Validates production-first philosophy. Go team targeting agent orchestration confirms Chained's domain importance.

key_insights.title: Zed Collaboration Platform - Editor as Office
key_insights.description: Real-time collaborative editing platform where Zed Industries team conducts meetings entirely within editor. Paradigm shift beyond Zoom/Slack fragmentation.
key_insights.evidence: 262 HN points (highest engagement), article describes all-hands meetings in shared editing environment
key_insights.application: Minor relevance. Validates real-time coordination patterns but Chained's A2A protocol already handles async-first agent coordination.

key_insights.title: Yaesu FT-70D Firmware - Embedded Systems RE
key_insights.description: Reverse engineering ham radio firmware encryption (Renesas H8SX microcontroller). Demonstrates embedded systems remain accessible hacking targets.
key_insights.evidence: 117 HN points, detailed methodology for firmware extraction and decryption
key_insights.application: Minimal relevance. Go's binary handling useful for tooling but no current Chained need for embedded device orchestration.

key_insights.title: Infrastructure Invisibility Pattern
key_insights.description: Go-powered infrastructure tools mentioned 63 times (Docker 35, K8s 9, Grafana 8) but Go language itself only 3 times. Success measured by invisibility.
key_insights.evidence: 6.3% infrastructure mentions vs 0.3% direct Go mentions - 20x usage vs attribution gap
key_insights.application: Validates specialization architecture. Best agents work seamlessly without drawing attention to implementation details.

key_insights.title: AI Infrastructure Opportunity
key_insights.description: Go team explicitly targeting 'robust AI integrations, products, agents, and infrastructure' with production-ready approach. Timeline: 2026-2027 maturity.
key_insights.evidence: Official announcement in Go's Sweet 16 blog post, google/adk-go development ongoing
key_insights.application: Strategic validation. Go team targeting same problem space (agent orchestration) as Chained. Monitor google/adk-go maturity for future evaluation.
